_comment: AI-generated — to be rewritten by me. Short answer cards shown ABOVE the search results when a question needs an explanation, not just a menu item. Hand-written (not recorded). scripts/build_menu_map.py checks it (item ids exist, message keys exist in extension/_locales/en/messages.json) and copies it to extension/data/answers.json. Matching: core/answers.py and extension/shared.js (answerFor), kept identical by tests/test_answers.py. A trigger matches when all its words are in the question (a, an, the, my, i, to are ignored; apostrophes removed), or, for a Korean trigger, when it is in the question with spaces removed. done_hints: a message shown when a guide to that item finishes.

answers.why: Reading-room seats are issued at the kiosks (1F A/B reading rooms, 3F, 4F; library page 열람실 좌석배정 이용). libseat roomStatus.php only shows free seats. What CAN be booked online: study rooms, cinema rooms, S-Lounge tables.
